fusions.name: Plague Courier
fusions.desc: Sends a diseased rat that deals 7 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Gnawing Horde
fusions.desc: Looses 5 rats at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 poison damage and ignoring resistances. 20% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cellar Swarm
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm of rats that lasts 20 seconds, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.

fusions.name: Gnawed Free
fusions.desc: When your health falls below half, you regain 5 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
